entities.name: Magosi
entities.description: Towering waterfall on the continent of Tazeem on Zendikar, the largest along the Umara River, with a busy portage.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: Continent of Zendikar where Magosi lies.

entities.name: Umara River
entities.description: River along which Magosi is the largest waterfall.

entities.name: Verazol
entities.description: Massive serpent that dwells in the dark waters behind Magosi and likely takes travelers who camp overnight.

events.summary: People mysteriously vanish at night at the Magosi portage, likely taken by Verazol.
events.quote: Numerous people have mysteriously vanished during the night

relations.note: Magosi is on the continent of Tazeem.
relations.quote: located on the continent of Tazeem within the plane of Zendikar

relations.note: Verazol dwells in the waters behind the waterfall.
relations.quote: the massive serpent that dwells in the dark waters concealed behind the waterfall
